newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL POWER PAST WESTERN PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL POWER PAST WESTERN PROVINCE.

text.p: Six second half tries put Transvaal into the last four of the Currie Cup as they ultimately cruised to a 56-22 victory (halftime 16-14) over Western Province in their quarter-final in Johannesburg on Saturday.
Transvaal trailed twice in a see-sawing first period in which the lead changed hands four times.

But two tries in the first five miunutes of the second half gave Transvaal a healthy 28-14 lead before they finished off a penalty prone and disjointed Province side with three goals in the final five minutes.
Transvaal wing Jannie van der Walt scored four of his side's seven tries while fullback Gavin Lawless was successful with nine out of 12 kicks at goal for a personal haul of 21 points.
Two of Western Province's three tries were outstanding long range efforts, started from inside their own 22, and led 14-13 with five minutes to go to the interval.
However they were overpowered by Transvaal in the second half and could show only a penalty and a try for scrumhalf Joggie Viljoen after an eight man passing movement over 80 metres.
Transvaal now meet Northern Transvaal at Loftus Versfeld in the semi-finals.
Transvaal - Tries: Jannie van der Walt (4), Joe Gillingham, Hennie le Roux, Bennie Nortje. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (6). Penalties: Lawless (3).
Western Province - Tries: Justin Swart, Pieter Rossouw, Joggie Viljoen. Conversions: Louis Koen (2). Penalties: Koen.
